quotes.text: You can use this public preview feature by including the version header `2026-07-29.preview` or a later preview version header in your API request.
Industry Metadata is in private preview for card transactions and public preview only for Klarna. Additionally, card transactions don’t support passing cruise data.

In live mode, you must use a valid phone number per E.164 standards. Begin non-US numbers with `+` and include the country code. If a US number begins with `+`, use country code `1` followed by the 10-digit number.
Make sure the data you provide is complete because `payment_details` can’t be modified after a PaymentIntent is captured.

old_evidence.text: You can use this public preview feature by including the version header `2025-11-17.preview` or a later preview version header in your API request.
Must be a valid phone number (numbers only), can also be all zeros (`0000000000`) in a sandbox
Make sure the data you provide is complete because `payment_details` can’t be modified after a PaymentIntent is captured.

findings: The same URL retains PaymentIntents industry metadata for supported travel and entertainment MCCs, with card network compliance requirements and only a possible Klarna authorization or risk benefit (new raw:13-28; old raw:12-27). The capture now states a 2026-07-29.preview or later preview header, replacing the old 2025-11-17.preview wording (new raw:11; old raw:10). This is a documented preview-version change, not proof an older header fails at runtime.

Card transactions remain private preview, Klarna public preview; card cruise data is unsupported, and flight-card metadata specifically requires feature enablement (new raw:43-45,205-207; old raw:42-44,205-207). The public-preview header alone must not be read as open card access.

The new field tables and repeated create, confirm, capture, and multi-vertical examples use total.tax.tax_items[] where the old tables and examples use total.tax.taxes[] for car rental, lodging, and flight (new raw:301-304,345-348,396-399,569-572,610-613,662-664; old raw:303-306,348-351,400-403,575-578,617-619,668-670). Preserve the old spelling as dated evidence, but do not silently present it as the new documented request path.

The new card car-rental and lodging customer-service phone rules and lodging property-phone rule specify valid E.164 numbers in live mode, including country code for non-US numbers and US country code 1 if prefixed with plus; all zeros remain a sandbox allowance (new raw:270-272,329-331,355-356; old raw:272-274,332-334,358-359). Current source:82's 'numbers only' phrasing conflicts with the new live format.

The samples switch from explicit payment_method_types[0]=card to automatic_payment_methods[enabled]=true, add return_url to confirm examples, and revise sample car daily rate and lodging total/tax numbers (new raw:534-673,679-814; old raw:540-679,687-817; diff:644-790). These are example changes; they do not establish automatic methods as required for industry metadata or a new monetary rule.

Unchanged boundaries remain consequential: cards send only each array's first entry to networks, Klarna processes all; payment-method-specific unsupported properties are ignored; payment_details updates replace the full hash; and metadata cannot be modified after capture (new raw:57-73,524-530,816-818; old raw:56-71,528-536,819-821). Sandbox success does not establish network interchange qualification or Klarna authorization outcomes (new raw:1042-1052; old raw:1045-1055).
substantive_changes: Public preview header wording changes from `2025-11-17.preview` or later to `2026-07-29.preview` or later (old raw:10; new raw:11).

The documented tax-entry path changes from `total.tax.taxes[]` to `total.tax.tax_items[]` across car-rental, lodging, and flight property tables and API examples (old raw:303-306,348-351,400-403; new raw:301-304,345-348,396-399).
Live phone validation is described in E.164 terms with explicit country-code treatment; the all-zero sandbox allowance remains (old raw:272-274,332-334,358-359; new raw:270-272,329-331,355-356).
historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain old 2025-11-17.preview, taxes[] path, and older phone wording as dated 2026-05-11 capture, without treating the new wording as proof of actual API rejection or a migration deadline.

Retain the private-preview card versus public-preview Klarna distinction, eligible MCC and brand scope, flight-card enablement, and unsupported cruise-data limit (old raw:18-44,205-207; new raw:19-45,205-207).

Retain cards-first-entry versus Klarna-all-entries behavior, full-hash replacement, capture finality, and the sandbox-outcome limitation (old raw:56-71,530-536,819-821,1055; new raw:57-73,524-530,816-818,1052).
conflicts: Current wiki/sources/source-stripe-industry-metadata.md:13 and wiki/concepts/stripe-industry-metadata.md:10 present `2025-11-17.preview` as the feature's unqualified current header; new raw:11 documents `2026-07-29.preview` or later. Revise the current guidance while retaining the earlier version as historical evidence and card private-preview qualification.

Current source:82 says phone numbers are 'numbers only' while the new live card fields require valid E.164 with leading plus for non-US numbers and a specified US-plus form (new raw:270-272,329-331,355-356). Revise that note, keeping the all-zero sandbox exception.

Current source:13 and concept:10 state Klarna authorization/risk improvement as an outcome, while both captures say industry data 'might improve' those outcomes (old raw:14; new raw:15). Qualify the retained benefit as possible, not guaranteed.

Current source:15 and concept:12 assert mutual exclusivity with payment line items, but this assigned page does not mention line items in either capture. Preserve as a separately sourced claim only if its linked source supports it; do not infer it from this comparison.
unresolved_questions: The page does not establish whether existing 2025-11-17.preview integrations fail after the documentation header change, whether taxes[] is rejected or aliased, or current account-specific feature enablement; no live API or provider test was authorized.
Payment-line-item mutual exclusivity requires its separate source for verification; this same-URL comparison supplies no direct evidence for that retained cross-feature claim.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/industry-metadata, the new capture still describes PaymentIntent payment_details arrays for car rental, lodging, and flight, with card private-preview access and Klarna public-preview access (new raw:43-65; old raw:42-63).
